main.description: The Radicle node identities this account vouches for. Each device holds its own key and never transports it; the account merely states 'this node is mine', proven by an SSHSIG that the device's own key makes over 'at.tessera.radicle.link.v1:<did>'. Losing a device therefore costs one entry, not a re-key. Top-level nid/linkSig are the OPTIONAL account-held identity (the passkey-vaulted one, which belongs to no machine); `devices` are machine-local keys. Either may be absent. Single record at rkey 'self'.

nid.description: Optional account-held node id — the passkey-vaulted identity, tied to no machine. Radicle node id (multibase base58btc of the Ed25519 public key, did:key style).

linkSig.description: SSH signature (ssh-keygen -Y sign, namespace 'at.tessera.radicle') by the account-held key over at.tessera.radicle.link.v1:<did>. Required whenever `nid` is present.

alias.description: Optional Radicle node alias for the account-held identity.

devices.description: Machine-local node identities. Each entry is vouched for by its own signature; removing one revokes that machine without touching any other.

nid.description: Radicle node id of the key that lives on this machine and never leaves it.

linkSig.description: SSH signature by THIS device's key over at.tessera.radicle.link.v1:<did>. Made on the machine, which is why no secret has to travel for the account to vouch for it.

name.description: Human label chosen by the owner, e.g. 'laptop'. Display only.

encPubkey.description: Optional X25519 public key of this machine, base64url, used to encrypt a private repository's key to it. HKDF-derived from the same Radicle key the NID encodes (label at.tessera.radicle.enc.x25519.v1) — derived rather than converted, so no key serves both signing and encryption and there is no second secret to back up. Absent on devices that predate encryption support.
